symptom.name: Arm jerks then stops
symptom.description: The arm jerks and then stops during motion.

failure_modes.name: Loose encoder cable at joint J2
failure_modes.description: The encoder cable at joint J2 is loose.

corrective_actions.name: Re-seat J2 encoder cable and tighten both connector screws
corrective_actions.description: Re-seat the J2 encoder cable and tighten the connector screws.
corrective_actions.instruction_text: Re-seat J2 encoder cable and tighten both connector screws.

symptom.name: Gripper will not close
symptom.description: The gripper will not close on command.

failure_modes.name: Low pneumatic pressure below 5 bar
failure_modes.description: Pneumatic supply pressure is below 5 bar.

corrective_actions.name: Restore air supply to 6 bar and repeat grip test
corrective_actions.description: Restore the pneumatic supply and repeat the grip test.
corrective_actions.instruction_text: Restore air supply to 6 bar and repeat grip test.
